title: Folger Shakespeare (online scholarly editions of Shakespeare's works)
notes:
Free online editions of all of Shakespeare's plays, sonnets and poems presenting the modern-spelling texts of the Folger Shakespeare Library print editions, downloadable in PDF, DOC, HTML, TXT, XML and TEI Simple (MorphAdorner-annotated) at no cost for noncommercial use; print-edition essays and notes are not included online. Single-author project, but a major scholarly edition series (cf. the Digital Donne Project already in the catalogue).

Justification: Found via the Folgerpedia list of digital editions of English Renaissance drama and the Folger download pages. A significant, freely accessible scholarly edition collection of English Renaissance drama (c. 1590–1613) with downloadable TEI Simple source; not in the catalogue (REED English and DraCor are listed, the Folger Shakespeare is not).
Found at: https://folgerpedia.folger.edu/Digital_editions_of_English_Renaissance_drama
